description: This file defines the 'Spelling' module, including classes for spellchecking backends, exception classes, and a base class for spellchecking providers. It provides an API for spellchecking and word suggestions, with platform-specific library selection.

classes.name: NoSuchLangError
classes.description: Exception raised when a specific language could not be found.

classes.name: NoLanguageSelectedError
classes.description: Exception raised when a language-using method is called but no language was previously selected.

classes.name: SpellingBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for all spelling providers, supporting language selection, word checking, and suggestions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the spelling provider, selecting a default or specified language.

methods.name: select_language
methods.description: Selects a language from the supported list for spellchecking.

methods.name: list_languages
methods.description: Returns a list of all supported languages.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if a word is valid in the current language.

methods.name: suggest
methods.description: Provides spelling suggestions or completions for a word fragment.
